Community Development Division
Our division administers the Building, Code Compliance Services, Planning, and Sewer or On-Site Wastewater Treatment Systems (OWTS) departments.
We provide inspections, permits, and current codes for building projects, correct code violations, guidance for an array of planning and development services, and ensure proper onsite wastewater disposal in areas which are not served by municipal sewer.

Our Departments
Building Department
Performs inspections, supplies permits, and current codes for building projects in our county, the towns of De Beque, Collbran, Palisade, and the City of Grand Junction.
Code Compliance Services
Correct code violations to improve the health, safety and aesthetic appearance of neighborhoods in Mesa County, foster orderly community development, and improve economic vitality.
Planning Department
Provides Mesa County citizens and businesses with guidance for an array of planning and development services to help create positive results for future growth in our community.
Septic Systems
Ensure proper onsite wastewater disposal in areas which are not served by municipal sewer.
